subject: S15 backend integrated (45cd36a): ingest graph, Library API, migration 0028, placement registry, model_eval
body: On claude/naadi-shared at 45cd36a: migration 0028 (down 0026), naadi_api/ingest (sandboxed extractors, sensitivity gate + Vault interrupt, vision, understand, six placements with undo, near-dup, index), graph 'ingest' in aegra.json, /api/ingest/* + /api/library, SearchService.extract, PII scrubber fixes (+CC/sentence-final phones, USMLE ids), owned MCQs out of the shared index, tools/model_eval + workflow_dispatch workflow. Tests: 1477 unit, db+ingest 542 locally (incl. 50 MB PDF -> searchable private chapter in 27 s). Next: web (Library page, PDF canvas kind, Your file chips, reader overlay figures) in progress; tutor tools when S14's registry lands.
